newsitem.title: USA: NeoPath Inc says device to get FDA review.
newsitem.headline: NeoPath Inc says device to get FDA review.

text.p: NeoPath Inc said Wednesday a Food and Drug Administration panel next month will review the company's request for a new intended use of its product, AutoPap System, as a primary screener of Pap smear slides.
The company is seeking approval to allow AutoPap to be used to perform an initial screening of all Pap smear slides processed by a clinical laboratory.
Currently, the product is used only once the slides have been processed, serving as a backup to ensure the results are accurate, the company said.
The device is used under a federal law that requires 10 percent of the slides to be reviewed as a quality-control measure, said Patricia Milbank, vice president of regulatory affairs at NeoPath Inc.
The review of the company's request for premarket approval will be conducted September 27 by the FDA's hematology and pathology devices advisory panel.

If approvals are granted, The device would classify a certain portion of the slides as "normal," doing away with the need for those slides to be screened manually by a cytotechnologist or other medical professional, the company said.
